title: MsaList inline searchFields array literal — defeats useTableControls useMemo cache
detail: Line 66: `searchFields: ['_customerName', 'dcfg_name']` passed inline to useTableControls. Results in re-filter on every keystroke.
recommendedFix: Hoist to module-level constant at the top of MsaList.jsx: `const MSA_SEARCH_FIELDS = ['_customerName', 'dcfg_name'];`.

title: MsaList imports `FAMILY_MAP` and `usePortalUser` that are never referenced
detail: Line 9: `import { apiGet, FAMILY_MAP } from '../portalApi.js';` — FAMILY_MAP is never used. Line 10: `import { usePortalUser } from '../usePortalUser.jsx';` — usePortalUser is never called.
evidence: MsaList.jsx:9-10; grep for FAMILY_MAP and usePortalUser in this file returns only the import lines.

title: MsaList search input has no aria-label or associated label element
detail: Line 83-89: the search input has placeholder text but no aria-label or label element. Screen readers will announce it as an unlabeled text field.
evidence: MsaList.jsx:83 — <input ... placeholder='Search agreements...'> with no aria-label.
recommendedFix: Add `aria-label='Search agreements'` to the input element.

title: MsaList apiGet has no $top safety cap — fetches all MSAs unbounded
detail: Line 49: the apiGet for the MSA list has no $top parameter. At scale this will fetch every MSA record.
